# Humsafar Community

> Humsafar Community is a group travel company based in Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh, India. It runs Saturday-departure group tours with a trip captain to Himalayan and other Indian destinations (Manali, Kasol, Spiti, Jibhi, Nainital, Mussoorie, Chambal Valley, Goa, Udaipur). Travellers can join from Gwalior or Delhi, or fly to Delhi and join from Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Hyderabad and Ahmedabad.

## Main pages
- [All tour packages](https://www.humsafarcommunity.com/packages): every group tour with price, duration and departure day
- [Manali tour packages](https://www.humsafarcommunity.com/manali-tour-packages)
- [Spiti Valley tour packages](https://www.humsafarcommunity.com/spiti-tour-packages)
- [Kasol tour packages](https://www.humsafarcommunity.com/kasol-tour-packages)
- [Jibhi tour packages](https://www.humsafarcommunity.com/jibhi-tour-packages)
- [Custom trips](https://www.humsafarcommunity.com/custom-trips): private and corporate trips planned on request
- [Travel guides (blog)](https://www.humsafarcommunity.com/blog): destination guides, itineraries and tips
- [About Humsafar Community](https://www.humsafarcommunity.com/about)

## Key facts
- Trips are group batches that depart on Saturdays, led by an experienced trip captain.
- Package pages list the day-wise itinerary, inclusions, exclusions, price per person and FAQs.
- Bookings and questions are handled on WhatsApp: +91 62684 96389.
- Location: Maharaj Wada, Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh, India.
